text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the morning of the NHK Mile Cup, Fuji 
Kiseki asked a certain junior to come 
watch her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki shares her passion for the 
mile route: she will put on the best race 
she possibly can. After all, on any stage, 
whether you shine depends entirely on the 
actor—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A mix of voices rose from the stands—some 
disappointed by her shift in course, 
others cheering passionately. Among the 
spectators was also one of her juniors...
